description.en: Mini Pi Plus is a compact, bipedal humanoid platform developed by High Torque Robotics for robotics research, teaching and competitions. It combines a head, torso, articulated arms and legs with the manufacturer’s integrated servo joint modules. The official product site describes an open developer ecosystem with Python and C++ SDKs, ROS support and simulation models. It is presented through official product and purchase-inquiry pages. Physical specifications are withheld because current official pages describe conflicting configurations under the same model name. The cover depicts the configuration shown in the official shop product listing.
